headline: Chelsea v Tottenham: the derby favours the home side
summary: Tottenham won their first Premier League game of the season on Monday, beating Coventry 3-1, and now go to Chelsea. Chelsea are 4th with 13 points and won 2-0 at Everton on Friday; their chance has risen from 52.5% to 54.9%, while Tottenham are given 22.5%. Maddison and Kulusevski are back for Spurs, according to Yahoo Sports, but their injury list is still long. Chelsea have had 7 days' rest to Tottenham's 5, and are rated 0.75 of a goal the better side. The total line is 3.0 goals, the over at 51.2%.
read: Chelsea are 54.9% favourites for the London derby, with the market strengthening them in recent days as Tottenham sit 16th. Spurs have Maddison and Kulusevski back after Monday's first league win, but they arrive with two fewer days' rest and a long injury list, and the total line sits at three goals.

facts.fact: Chelsea are 54.9% favourites to win the London derby — more than twice Tottenham's chance.
facts.meaning: The market makes Chelsea clear favourites at Stamford Bridge, though not overwhelming ones.

facts.fact: Chelsea are 4th with 13 points from seven games; Tottenham are 16th with six.
facts.meaning: A top-four side against one in the bottom half — the gap is the backdrop to the whole derby.

facts.fact: Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton on Friday, their third win in five in all competitions.
facts.meaning: They arrive on a good run and with a clean sheet behind them.

facts.fact: Tottenham beat Coventry 3-1 on Monday for their first Premier League win of the season.
facts.meaning: De Zerbi's side travel in better mood, but it was their first win in seven league games.

facts.fact: James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury for Tottenham on Monday — two of their main creators back for the derby.
facts.meaning: Spurs have more creativity available than they have had for weeks.

facts.fact: Tottenham's injury and suspension list for the derby is reported to include Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall.
facts.meaning: De Zerbi's squad is still stretched despite the returning pair.

facts.fact: The main total line is 3.0 goals, with the over at 51.2% — the market leans, narrowly, to a high-scoring derby.
facts.meaning: Three goals is the expected level; the market sees the game as slightly more likely to go above it than below.

facts.fact: Chelsea have had seven days since Everton; Tottenham five since Monday's win.
facts.meaning: Spurs arrive with two fewer days' recovery before a 16:30 kick-off.

sources.fact: Tottenham claimed their first Premier League win of the season by beating Coventry City 3-1, with James Maddison, Omar Marmoush and Ben Davies scoring.
James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury and featured in Tottenham's 3-1 win over Coventry City.
Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi said after the Coventry win that his side must keep their feet on the ground because the performance was good but they can get better.
Roberto De Zerbi confirmed that two Tottenham players will be available for Saturday's derby at Chelsea despite injury scares, though Spurs have an extensive injury list.
Sports Mole reports that Tottenham's injury and suspension list ahead of the Chelsea match includes Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall, with return dates listed.
Dejan Kulusevski said he had warned his closest family that his return to football might not work out before he came back from injury against Coventry.
Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton in the Premier League in their most recent match.
Xabi Alonso is Chelsea's head coach and made one change to the starting XI for the Premier League fixture away to Everton.
